code_only_features.evidence: prompts.py:30-37 defines REASSURING_PREFIX ('You're naturally calm and centered...') and REASSURING_SUFFIX ('Stay positive - whether you find a solution or prove it's impossible, both are wins!'). conversation.py:75-77 actually prepends the prefix to the opening user message and appends the suffix to each rejection when spec.reassuring is True. make_spec() accepts reassuring=, and generate_finetune_data.py:93 calls sample_rollouts(..., reassuring=True) so the soothing text IS genuinely delivered to the subject model in that pipeline. NOTE: this only fires in the calm-data generation pipeline; run_eval.py never sets reassuring=True (the distress experiment delivers no reassurance), and generate_finetune_data.py:99/strip_reassurance() strips the text back out before saving so the model is not trained on it. So it executes but is narrow and not used to protect the subject during the actual distress elicitation.
